name: Wooden Double Ring Box
description:
KEY FEATURES

  • Premium Material:
    - Crafted from premium walnut wood, offering a warm, elegant, and timeless presentation.
    - Features a sturdy wooden exterior with a refined natural grain pattern, making each box unique and sophisticated.
    - Includes a clear acrylic panel on the lid for personalized printing and enhanced visual appeal.
    - Acrylic thickness: 2mm, providing a sleek and durable decorative surface.
    - Soft inner lining helps protect rings from scratches while keeping them securely in place.
    - Magnetic closure design offers convenient opening and closing while adding a premium finishing touch.

 

  • Sizes & Dimensions:
    - Overall size: 9.8 x 4.9 x 2.8 cm ~ 3.86 x 1.93 x 1.1 in.
    - Inner slot size: 4.6 x 3.7 cm ~ 1.81 x  1.46 in.
    📌 Note: The shape is fixed and cannot be changed. Customers may customise only the printed design.

 

  • Printing Technology:
    - Uses advanced UV printing technology for sharp details, vibrant colors, and long-lasting image quality.
    - Features single-sided printing on the acrylic lid panel for a clean and refined appearance.

 

  • Functional & Usage:
    - Functions as both a ring holder and a meaningful keepsake box.
    - Designed to store and present engagement rings, wedding bands, or promise rings beautifully.
    - Compact and lightweight, making it easy to carry during wedding ceremonies, proposals, or photoshoots.
    - Ideal for ring bearer use, jewelry display, and special event presentation.
    - Perfect for preserving treasured rings in a stylish and protective box.

 

  • Perfect Gift for Any Occasion:
    - A meaningful personalized gift for couples, fiancés, newlyweds, and loved ones.
    - Perfect for proposals, engagements, weddings, anniversaries, and vow renewals.
    - Ideal for ring bearers, wedding day details, and romantic keepsake collections.
    - A thoughtful gift for preserving precious moments and symbolic jewelry pieces.
    - Great for bridal showers, wedding photography props, and elegant memory keepsakes.
    - Adds a warm, refined, and sentimental touch to every special occasion 🎁 

 

SPECIFICATION

  • Processing Time: 1 – 3 working days on average after payment and all designs updated correctly
  • Shipping Time: 6 – 9 working days on average (US)
  • Packaging: 1 x  Wooden Double Ring Box

 

PRODUCTION

  • Manufacturer: Made by Printway
  • The tracking Country Origin is the US

Print Guidelines

Below is our complete selection of art templates used for designing within the full printable area of our products. Each template comes with a .png detailing Safe Area, Bleed, etc. Download templates and mockups here

 

To use an Art Template:

  • Open the Printway template for your selected product in Photoshop or another design program.
  • Insert your artwork in a new layer, placing all important parts of your design within the designated “Safe zone” on the art template to ensure your design will not be cut off during the printing process.
  • If you’re designing drinkware, use the indicated centering lines to ensure your artwork is placed exactly where you’d like.
  • Hide or delete the Art Template layer from your file.
  • Save as a .png, .jpg, or another accepted file type.
  • You’ve now used a Printway template to create artwork exactly to the recommended specs for that product.

 

To ensure your design prints properly on each product:

  • Ensure all important elements of your design are within the safe zone on the product template.
  • Fill the entire design template! The outer edge of the template represents “Bleed Area,” which signifies the areas which may print on the outer edges of your product.
  • Failure to fill the bleed area will likely result in unprinted white unprinted areas around the edge of your product.
